name: stakewise-data-query
description: Ask natural-language questions in any language about StakeWise V3 staking data on Mainnet and Gnosis — APY, vault TVL, your stake or earnings, exit-queue ETA, osETH/osGNO mint capacity or health factor, boost position, leverage borrow LTV, distributor claims, vesting positions, transaction history, exchange rates, or sub-vaults. Read-only; talks to public StakeWise subgraphs and backend GraphQL via WebFetch / curl. No SDK install or local server required.
